Modern 1-Bedroom Apartment in Al Manara Tower, Jumeirah Village Triangle

Experience elevated urban living in this beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment in Al Manara Tower, a 28-storey residential high-rise located in the vibrant heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT). This development offers sweeping views of the Dubai skyline and a refined lifestyle tailored for modern living.

The tower features a collection of 257 contemporary apartments, thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts and large windows that invite natural light and city views into every room. Residents enjoy access to a range of upscale amenities including a swimming pool, fitness facilities, retail outlets, and dedicated indoor play areas for children.

Positioned in a prime location with seamless connectivity to Dubai’s key destinations and business hubs, Al Manara Tower provides a perfect balance of convenience and comfort. Whether you're looking to make it your home or secure a solid investment, this property offers a lifestyle where everything you need is within reach.
